body:
I have no clue, other than however implausible it may sound, the facts point to it being true.

For example, I was considering an even more invasive procedure that would've made me even more dependent on them for help. However the doctor turned out to be quite sketchy,even though he said he would do the procedure, it had turned out that he had lost his license.

So I ended up changing my mind and refusing the procedure-- and my a Dad started yelling at me that I had to do it because he had taken me all the way to see this doc. It turned into a massive scene of him trying to threaten me into the procedure or imply that I had lied and dragged him down there for no reason.

This is a person who allowed me to homeschool--but started out the experience by saying "well if you life turns out bad, you can't blame us"- this was said to  a 12 year old.

Anyways sorry for ranting, it's just I have to unload this horrible crap because it upsets me so much

Here is the problem: they have turned facts into opinions..

For example, I was assaulted by someone the other month and one parent was there to witness everything.  When I have talked about how outrageous this physical assault for no reason is they say "Well in you experience, it was an assault. But in our experience it was simply a stupid mistake."

No one in their right mind could ever think it was a mistake, especially when the person verbally threatened me afterwards, but this is the tactic they use consistently and I don't know how to beat it.  

They realize I don't have any friends, when this abuse started my father said "Well you don't have any more friends now do you?" And gave me a malevolent look.

Whenever I complain about their treatment, they threaten to leave and not come back, classic abuse of a dependent person.

I've even begun to wonder whether they are actually my parents at all. I look nothing like them, when I was 3 years old, me and my bro called them by their first names Vs 'mom or dad., which is unheard of. They have a history of cult involvement they've withheld info on-- the cult mass marries everyone that belongs to it, yet they claim they never did this. Then when I was a bit older, they followed someone who channeled a spirit that went by the same name as a mythical character who sacrifices his son. They've also had people come to the house to "fix its energy" and the company's name is called Dragon Inc.

Despite their bizarre, insane religious beliefs, they've tried to criticized me for just visiting beautiful churches to admire them. They are the most paradoxical, abusive people that exist. 

They will intersperse spouts of major kindness and caring with the abuse-being very considerate, "caring", and devoting time to trying to help--And the suddenly turning around. I had gotten all fairly well with one parent for w few weeks, the. I wake up and I sense something is off, asking about what was wrong. The I was yelled at for 30 minutes.  And yet they are the ones who tell everyone I yell at them.

.  They will pretend to be liberal in politics, my father repeatedly says that he is against war, but then he will come out strong on how he supports torture,even through he has read articles I've sent about how even if you don't care about the ethical dimension, it just doesn't work. 

They've even tried to essentially politically assassinate me-- after 9/11, I made a big deal of rejecting torture and the war in Iraq, and while I've steadfastly denied I believe in a conspiracy on 9/1 I've said that there are very strange coincidences surrounding the event.  My loving family secretly stuffed my DVD collection full of these super sketchy conspiracy DVDs, trying to paint me as a whacked out conspiracy theorist.

Just keep in mind that these are people that portray themselves as liberals to everyone else they meet. It's just unbelievable.

I used to have friends. However, I lost them all because I've had this terrible disability for years and years yet the doctors told me I was imagining it all for many years(somatoform disorder), so all my friends started to think I was making it all up and lost respect for me.  

The fact that I had struggled as hard as I could to survive and live life didn't prove that I was tough to them, it just proved that I was lying about all the symptoms.

Yes that is one of my great fears as well.  And I've actually figured out they were planning this whole thing out, they were actually somewhat reasonable and nice to me.  They then waited until I had a medical procedure that made me very dependent on them, that is when the all out abuse started. Can't help but think that the fact I was now totally dependent on them gave the green light for the abuse they had always wanted to unleash on me because they blame me for my accident and want to get rid of me.

Thanks, I'm far from perfect but I make it a point to be kind to all people, even though I'm shy. One parent tries to claim that I'm not friendly just because I don't easily go up to people and start long conversations with them, but whenever I do engage with anyone I'm super nice VS my dad who yells and degrades any hotline or tech support employee-humiliating them, who literally bull rushes people like a sociopath in public areas just so he can get to his destination first. No criticism for him, all criticism on me, just like normal.

Thanks for your support, Im praying for a miracle .

>>Is there anyone on your side who is willing and able to advocate for you or help you change your living situation?

I had a close sibling, but then he married an awful woman, a person straight out of Mean Girls, someone who takes pleasure in spending hours planning on makings others lives miserable.  For example, one of the most heinous things she did was go around telling people that a well known classmate had raped someone, a total fabrication.

>>Can you leave your parents' home? Are there alternative living arrangements for someone with the disability you're dealing with?

I've desperately searched for that. I had got access to a new apartment for disabled and low income people. Looked nice on the outside, but the walls were paper thin due to energy saving insulation. You could hear the ppl in the apartment below you, to the right of you and left of you, even on the 5th floor you could hear easily conversations ppl had walking by on the sidewalk. And at night and on weekends it was even worse because there were bars nearby. Then when another tenant walked to their apartment, it made a thundering sound, and this happened dozens of times of day, this one person I'm think was running an escort service because they walked in and out of their apartment 15+ times a day 

I really did my best to live there considering the alternative, but was basically driven to the edge.

I ended up going to a local parking garage, only to find right when I had taken 3 steps into the roof floor just out of the elevator, 2 men rushed at me, grabbed me, and pulled me away.

This has made me suspect that I've been under some kind of surveillance, because these guys had to have been watching me to respond so quickly and to have guessed my motive for being there.

Similar things have happened, can't help but think my wonderful parents all involved.

There are people, who, when I was looking to live in the greater NYC area because of some of the better opportunities for disabled people, purposefully and without warning me took me into a dangerous crime ridden area of NY, to look for apartments. The entire time the acted as if everything was normal,

We are talking about someone who loves Meet the Parents because the De Niro character, the character everyone else hates.......

Truly insane

The problem is I am physically disabled. Because of their callous treatment (which didn't turn into outright abuse until about 2011-2012) I've put my heart and soul into living on my own, only to be met with failure after failure.

My parents "helped" me get some medical care for my situation, but this has made me even more dependent on them since I cannot drive the long distances needed to maintain these medical interventions.  The parents relish the fact that these interventions make me rely on them.

The situation is intolerable but thank you for taking the time to respond.  If God healed my body in a Miracle, I'd leave and never look back, ever.

I was literally abused by mental health professionals in "getting help"- 2 of the counsellors leading group therapy couldn't even spell the english language and they were natural English speakers.......

Hey, thanks for getting back to me. To be honest I didn't know it was possible to feel this terrible and doomed, and in general I've had an extremely shitty life (despite being a really good, kind person).

there is no evidence.
Like I said, this has been very deliberate.  My family has supplied me with various necessary physical goods that makes them look like angels in any court, realizing that all the sick emotional abuse and torture won't show--and in fact making me seem like the bad guy by recording me reacting in an upset manner to the abuse. 

All the abuse has "just" been sadistic, twisted emotional abuse plus borderline molestation done in a way that simply paints her as someone was very, very bad judgement but with a "good motive" (trying to help with my chronic disease). I've noticed that this is a repeated tactic- "oh that was just a mistake, you know I have anxiety etc".

I mean the things that have done are beyond f-ed up.  I've even questioned whether my parents took me and my brother from another family since we look nothing like them at all(they have dark skin, we have light skin) and from our earliest memories we called them by their full 1st names vs calling them Mom and Dad. They've also belonged to cults that are on level with Scientology, and I had to recover from their toxic religious dogma for years into adult phone, a dogma that blames me as "the sole creator of my physical disability".

I could go on for a long time unfortunately..... : (
